post-install-output: before going live: these are your legal pages, published as written.

contents: # Fineprint — the legal pages of this site. Every fact below is published as written:
# replace each "CHANGE ME" before going live. Reference: vendor/acencyril/fineprint-bundle/README.md
# Not legal advice: have your pages reviewed.
jurisdiction: fr                            # fr (French law) or eu (any EU country, EU law only)
activities: [b2b]                           # b2b, b2c, digital, subscription, physical_goods, marketplace, services
legal_name: 'CHANGE ME'                 # company name, or first and last name
legal_form: 'CHANGE ME'                 # e.g. entrepreneur individuel (micro-entreprise), SAS
company_id: '00000000000000'            # the SIRET in the "fr" pack
# phone: '+33 0 00 00 00 00'            # the LCEN asks professional publishers for one
publication_director: 'CHANGE ME'       # required by the "fr" pack
host:                                       # name, address and phone required by the "fr" pack
# Required by the "fr" pack as soon as activities include b2c.
# parent_template: 'base.html.twig'         # must define the "title" and "body" blocks
#     cookies: false                        # switch a page off
#             override: { law: 'legal.law' }   # a translation key, or a template.html.twig
#                 - { id: quotes, title: 'Quotes', body: 'CHANGE ME', position: 'after:order' }
# vat_exempt: true                      # "fr": TVA non applicable, art. 293 B du CGI
#     mail: { name: 'CHANGE ME', role: email, country: 'France' }
purpose: { fr: 'Sécurité du site (journaux du serveur)', en: 'Site security (server logs)' }
data: { fr: 'adresse IP, pages demandées, date', en: 'IP address, pages requested, date' }
legitimate_interest: { fr: 'protéger le site contre les attaques', en: 'protecting the site from attacks' }
purpose: { fr: 'Session, nécessaire aux formulaires', en: 'Session, needed by forms' }
duration: { fr: 'Fin de la session', en: 'End of session' }
# Legal pages under /{locale}/, built from config/packages/fineprint.yaml.
# A disabled page has no route.
